tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /hor rtsa bod rtsar song ba'i spyi 'gro yod// shrī sa skya ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i yi ge/ yangs pa'i rgyal khams na 'khod pa'i skye 'gro spyi dang / bye brag hor rtsa bod rtsa gnam mtsho phyug mo'i sa dang 'dab 'byor du 'khod pa'i 'gro ba dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum gnas su 'dzin cing / khyad par dpal sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa la lhag par dad cing 'phral yun gyi phan bde don du gnyer ba mtha' dag la springs pa/ 'phags bod mkhas grub yongs kyi rgya cher bsngags yul mchog tu gyur pa dpal sa skya'i gdung rabs rin po che 'di nyid thog mar rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi gdul bya spyi dang / khyad par gang ljongs 'dir snyigs dus kyi 'gro ba mtha' dag la thugs rjes lhag par dgongs te 'od gsal lha'i yul du spyi ring g.yu ring g.yu se zhes bya ba'i rnam par rol pa bstan te 'od kyi lam nas bod yul shel tsha rgyal gangs kyi rtse la phebs te/ de'i nang tshan g.yu ses mi rje mdzad pa nas bzung g.ya' spang skyes kyi bar du byon pa'i gdung rabs la 'od gsal lha yi gdung brgyud du grags/ des srin po skya rengs khrag med brtul nas chung ma g.ya' 'brum si li ma khab tu bzhes pa la 'khon bar skyes 'khrungs nas 'khon rog shes rab tshul khrims kyi bar du byon pa la 'khon gyi gdung rabs su grags shing / de'i nang nas 'khon klu'i dbang po ni bod kyi rab byung gi thog ma sad mi mi bdun gyi nang tshan bod la bka' drin che ba'i lo tsā ba chen por grags/ shes rab tshul khrims kyi gcung po bla chen dkon mchog rgyal pos dpal chen pho brang gi ri rtse nas sa dpyad legs par gzigs te/ chu mo glang gi lo bod kyi rdo rje gdan sa skya'i gtsug lag khang rnams kyi thog mar sgo rum gzim spyil dkar po btab pa nas bzung gnas kyi ming gdung brgyud la thog ste ming sa skya pa zhes grags/

de lta bu'i gnas mchog khyad par can 'di ni nges pa kho nar rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis byin gyis rlabs pa'i gnas chen yin pa'i nges tshigs yang dag par snang ste/ sngon gyi dus su sangs rgyas sman gyi bla'i rnam par sprul pa g.yu thog yon tan mgon pos 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa grub thob yon tan dpal rtsad gcod mdzad pa'i tshe/ dpal sa skya'i ri bo'i ldebs la bla ma de bzhugs pa'i phug pa yod par mkhyen nas/ de nyid kyi drung du chos gsan par phebs pa'i tshe bco lnga sogs dus khyad par can la ri de'i ngos la byams pa 'jam dbyangs gnyis bgro gling mdzad ces sogs yon tan mgon po de nyid kyi rnam thar na gsal zhing / de'i rjes su jo bo rje dpal ldan mar me mdzad mnga' ris nas dbus su phebs skabs sa skya dang nye ba'i la rtse zhig nas/ deng sang dpon po rir grags pa'i ldebs la 'brong chen gnyis rtswa za zhing bag phebs ngur sgra sgrogs pa gzigs tshe/ 'khor rnams kyis ci'i ltas lags zhus pas/ ma 'ongs pa na gnas pha gir ma hā kā la gnyis kyis chos skyong mdzad par 'dug ces sa skya pa'i chos skyong che chung lung bstan zhing / de phyin de'i ming la 'brong ngur lar grags/ de nas sa skya'i lung mdar phebs pa'i tshe chibs bshol nas sa dkar po ngos la phyag mchod rgyas par mdzad/ 'khor rnams kyis ci lags zhus pas sa dkar gyi ldebs la dhīḥyig bdun dang hrīḥyig gcig hūm̐ yig gcig bcas 'dug pas ma 'ongs pa na 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa bdun dang / phyag rdor dang spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa re re gnas pha gir thog mar byon/ de nas rigs gsum mgon po'i sprul pa rgyun mi chad par 'byon pa'i ltas su 'dug ces gsungs pa dang / bla ma sa skya pa chen po dgung lo bcu gnyis kyi tshe 'jam dbyangs kyi sgrub pa mdzad skabs thog mar mi g.yo ba dang / sgrol ma/ de nas zla ba drug nas 'jam pa'i dbyangs bzang po'i 'dug stangs can zhal gzigs nas/

zhen pa bzhi bral gyi chos gsungs par grags shing / khyad par mi nas mir gyur pa'i skye ba nyi shu rtsa lngar 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis rjes su bzung ba'i sa paṇ+ḍita kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mdo rgyud rig gnas dang bcas pa rgya cher spel te/ mu stegs kyi ston pa ring du sbyangs pa dag kyang lung rig gi sgo nas tshar bcad nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che la 'jug par mdzad pa sogs mdor na tshad thub kyi lo rgyus du mas gnas 'di 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi byin gyis rlabs pa'i gnas mchog khyad par can yin pa ni yang dag par grub cing / de lta bu'i gnas mchog khyad par can 'dir gong du smos pa'i 'chi med 'khon ni sa skya'i gdung rabs rigs gsum mgon po'i rnam sprul sha stag rgyun mi chad par byon pa'i thog mar 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po'i sras spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam par sprul pa bla ma sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po ni bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi mnga' bdag dus gcig la sku'i bkod pa sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi rnam par rol pa du ma ston nus pa de nyid kyi sras 'jam dbyangs kyi sprul pa bsod nams rtse mo ni/ chu bo gaṅgā tshun chad 'gran zla med pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa sku lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod la gshegs shing / de'i gcung gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje'i rnam par sprul pa rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan ni mkhas grub yongs kyi gtsug rgyan rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa du ma dang ldan cing / mkhas pa chen po shākya shrī sogs du ma'i spobs pa 'phrog cing rgya 'dre gdug pa can rgya mtsho'i mthar skrod pa sogs grub pa'i sa chen po la bzhugs pa/ de'i dbon 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam par sprul pa sa skya paṇ+ḍi dang 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan gnyis ni mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i bdag po grub pa mchog gi dbang phyug tu gyur nas mu stegs dang zing shing gi ston pa sogs lung rig gi sgo nas tshar bcad/

de yang thar pa'i lam la bkod/ stobs kyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po gong ma dang jing gir sogs kyi spyi bos gtugs te chol kha gsum dang khri skor bcu gsum mchod gzhis su phul ba la brten nas gangs can bstan pa'i bdag po sa skya pa zhes 'gran zla thams cad dang bral bar gyur pa/ de lta bu'i rje btsun gong ma lnga'i dbon gyi nang nas bla ma bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal la gdung sras mang du byon pa la tri shrī kun dga' blo gros kyis bdag nyid chen po mya ngan las 'das rjes gdung brgyud rnams la dam kha dang bla brang go bzhi gnang ba las bzhi thog gdung brgyud thog mar rdzogs/ de nas rin chen sgang pa'i gdung brgyud/ lha khang bla brang pa'i gdung brgyud rnams kyang rim bzhin chad/ dus mchod bla brang pa'i gdung brgyud rgyun ma chad par bzhugs/ de dag gi gnas skabs su thog mar gdan sa chen po dar rgyas shin tu che skabs dgon pa dbon pos hor dmag drangs nas zhabs 'dren zhu 'dod byas kyang bla ma dang chos skyong gi nus pas gdan sa chen por ci yang ma skyon/ de rjes si tu byang rgyal ba'i dmag byung skyabs mgon gnas rten dang bcas pa la shin tu nyer 'tshe che zhing bod kyi bde skyid nyams pa'i snga ltas shar/ de rjes lha gnas sogs bstan dgra tshab po che rnams kyis gdan sa chen po 'di nyid dus ngan mtshan gyi lhag mar btang skabs/ dus mchod bla brang pa'i gdung brgyud sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i sku'i dbon po 'jam mgon grub pa'i dbang phyug dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes ci mdzad bstan pa dang sems can gyi don du gyur pa'i rnam 'dren dam pa de nyid kyis zhi rgyas dbang drag thabs mkhas sna tshogs kyi sgo nas rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan pa'i me ro rmang nas gsos te/

de dag gi rgyun mi nyams pa'i phyir 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams dbang po dang sems dpa' chen po grags pa blo gros gnyis rigs sras su bskrun par mdzad pa'i grags pa'i mtshan can la sras gsum byon pa'i gcung sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes snyan pa'i ba dan srid pa gsum na g.yo ba/ de'i sras 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug de'i sras sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis/ de'i sras nged rang gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang bsod nams rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i bar du byon pa'i skyes chen dam pa de thams cad kyis kyang bstan pa dang / sems can gyi don kho na phyag bzhes su gnang ba ni kun gyi thugs la gsal zhing / de ltar rje btsun gong ma rim par byon pa de dag gis 'debs par mdzad pa'i gtsug lag khang kyang gdan sa chen po'i yang rtse/ pad dkar po'i nub phyogs sgo rum gzim spyil dkar po'i phu nas 'phags yul nas byon pa'i mgon po'i 'chams sku ngo mtshar can/ mdo na rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi gzim mal sku 'dra/ steng bla ma lha khang na gtsang nag thugs rje dpal la sgrol mas lung bstan bzhin bzhengs pa'i sa paṇa gyi sku 'dra phyag nas ma/ 'phags pa rin po che'i sku 'dra rme ba can sogs kyi thog drangs bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang / dpe khang na mal lo/ sgyi chu ba/ rje btsun gong ma lnga'i phyag dpes thog drangs gsung pod byin rlabs can bzhi stong la nye ba/ li ma lha khang na gdung rten byin rlabs can sogs/ thugs rten tshad med dang / gzhan yang bum sku sogs sku rten mang ba/ 'khon rogs dang rje btsun gong ma lnga'i thog drangs bla ma gong ma'i phyag cha dbang rdzas na bza' sogs byin rten gyi rigs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas pa bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang de'i zhol na/

dbu rtse rnying ma'i phu na sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i pra bzo mdzad cing lha dang mi'am rin po che du mas lugs gcig mar byon pa'i 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sku byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar bas thog drangs sku rten kha shas/ mda' na sa paṇa gyi phyag bris 'jam dbyangs gar gzigs ma dang / lam 'bras bla brgyud gser zangs las grub pa che bas thog drangs sku rten mang ba/ dbu rtse gsar ma nas bde kyai kun rig gi blos blangs/ byang phyogs na mgon khang chung ngu / de 'og rnam thar sgo gsum na thub pa/ byang chub chen po sogs gser zangs kyi sku brnyan che gras kha yar/ rnying ma'i steng du bla ma lha khang na sa chen gyi sman sku chen po sogs rten stobs che ba/ thu mi sam+bho ṭa'i phyag bris yum glegs bam gyi thog drangs pusti drug stong nye ba tsam dang / rje btsun sa paṇa gyi gdung thal mchod rten gyis thog drangs thugs rten mtha' yas bcas thams cad la mchod pa'i yo byad gya nom pas bskor ba dang / de dang ha cang mi ring ba'i lho nub phyogs na ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags kyis bzhengs pa'i rnam rgyal sku 'bum gyi gzungs bzhugs la/ sangs rgyas 'od srung gi snam sbyar dang / de'i ring bsrel pham gang / rnam rgyal gyi gzungs grangs med bcas bzhugs pa la rab gnas mdzad pa'i tshe ngo mtshar che ba'i ltas bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ba'i sku 'bum de'i 'dab 'byor la bdag cag gi rnam 'dren dam pa de nyid kyis bzhengs par mdzad pa'i rnam rgyal gtsug lag khang chung ngu mchod pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa bzhugs shing / de nas lho phyogs rgyang tsam gyi sa na/ zhu yas kyi g.yu mes sgron bya ba bla ma ba ri lo tsā ba'i phyag tu byung ba la gzhi rten mdzad nas lo tsā ba de nyid kyi thugs dam rten gsung 'byon sgrol ma bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs pa'i de'i mtshan yang g.yu mkhar mor grags pa'i lha khang na sgrol ma'i rnam sprul bu mo gzhon nu'i tshul 'dzin gsung byon sgrol ma la dngos su thim zhing /

de nyid gzungs la bzhugs pa'i sman 'dam gyi sgrol sku bzhengs pa la sems dpa' sum brtsegs su grags pa'i gtsug lag khang dang / de steng 'chi med lha khang bcas su sku gsung thugs rten mchod pa'i yo byad dang bcas bzhugs pa'i byang phyogs ha cang thag mi ring ba na dbus gtsang khri skor bcu gsum las mir bskul don la bla chen chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pas bzhengs pa'i lha chen sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang na sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i nang rten thub chen 'dzam gling g.yas bzhag gis thog drangs gser zangs kyi sku brnyan sku tshad shin tu mtho ba grangs mang zhing / yum rgyas pa yongs rdzogs glegs bam gcig la bzhugs pa'i pusti lcags lung mar grags pas thog drangs gsung rab susti khri phrag brgal tsam dang / nged rang gi nu bo rgyan mchog gi nang rten dngul gdung 'dzam gling 'od gsal gyis thog drangs thugs rten thog tshad ma du ma dang / khyams stod byang bkra shis lha khang na grags pa 'od zer gyi nang rten gyi thog drangs gser zangs kyi sku chen kha shas bcas la mchod pa'i yo byad blos dpag par dka' ba dang / gtsug lag khang de nyid kyi steng na thigs g.yab chen mo yongs rdzogs sku dang thugs rten mchod chas tshad med kyi yongs su gang zhing / de'i byang steng na lam 'bras lha khang dang / 'og na mgon khang khyad par can/ khyams lho na gro bzhin sgrub mchod skabs zhal 'byed rgyu'i zhal thang byin rlabs can sum brgyar nye ba/ khyams smad byang phu na dus 'khor ba sogs kyi nang rten sa 'bum thog tshad ma kha shas sogs byin rlabs can mang ba/ mthong smon bla brang na brtse chen lha khang / lha khang bla brang na gtsang khang phu mda'/ dbang khang mgon khang dang / bzhi thog pho brang na gzim shar bde chen 'od gsal/ mgon khang rdo rje'i gur khang / gnas bcu lha khang dang / dbang khang smin grol bde ba can/

de'i phu mgon khang bdud las rnam rgyal/ dpe khang chos mdzod chen mo/ e waṃ byang chub 'byung gnas/ tshoms dmar byin rlabs can/ rgya gar lha khang rdo rje'i gdan/ rgya nag lha khang ri bo rtse lnga/ mkha' spyod dpal gyi pho brang / dpe khang rnying ma dus phyis dbang rdzas lha khang / mgon khang khyad 'phags lho/ dngul gdung rig 'dzin lha khang / de 'og mgon khang bdud las rnam rgyal/ tshoms chen dam chos khang bzang / bla ma lha khang mthong ba don ldan/ de 'og mgon khang dpal mgon dga' tshal/ de 'og tshoms bar mgon khang rnam sras bang mdzod/ mgon khang dngos grub gling / rnam sras lha khang lcang lo can rnams dang / bla brang shar steng shod na gtsug lag khang bzhi/ g.yu thog na gsum/ 'bum thang phyi nang / dga' ldan bla brang / 'khon sku 'bum rdo khang na gnyis/ shāka bzang na lnga/ zur khang / mthong ba don yod na gsum/ mngon dga' bde ba can na gnyis/ rin bzang sku 'bum/ sgang mkhar sku 'bum/ gzhon dbang sku 'bum/ bde mchog na gsum/ gdung rabs lha khang / bde chen gling / byang chub mchod rten/ mgon khang nub/ phyi rten skor/ mon chung / nang so pu tra khang / chos khri chen mo steng 'og dus mchod bla brang na gsum/ bla brang grong chen na gsum/ dge 'phel nyi lde na gnyis/ zhal re lha khang na gnyis/ bla brang rdzang chung na gsum/ bla brang rin chen sgang na gnyis/ gdan pa chen po nas rgyangs grags lnga tsam gyi sa na phru ma dang skyed lhas sgrub sde bcas bsdoms gtsug lag khang brgya tsam/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro mas bzhengs pa'i mchod rten rnams kyis thog drangs sku 'bum grangs mang dang / de'i shar phyogs rgyangs tsam gyi sa na byas 'gyur sgrub sde'i gtsug lag khang / phug pa/ sgrub chu/ sku 'bum bcas sdom bcu phrag lhag tsam dang / gdan sa'i lho phyogs bsam brling lha mo khang bcas de thams cad na mkhas grub dam pa rnams kyi phyag nas dang thugs dam ma sku gsung thugs rten byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba blo'i rwa ba las 'das par bzhugs shing /

de dag 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi byed po 'khon rigs gong ma rnams ni rigs gsum mgon po dang / 'khon rigs gong rgyan drug mchog gnyis sogs 'phags chen dam pa rnams kyi rnam sprul sha stag yin tshul rgyal ba'i bka' dang rgya bod mkhas grub yongs kyi mgrin gcig mngags pa de dag thams cad kyang chung ngu nas mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi yon tan mtha' dag la dbang bsgyur ba'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes chen 'gran bral sha stag dang / 'khon rigs kyi tha shal kho bo dag chung ngu nas dam pa du mas rjes su bzung shing / de dag gi bka' drin las thob pa'i mdo rgyud man ngag dang bcas pa la rang gi dbang pos ci lcogs thos bsam sgom gsum byed khul gyi sgo nas shi gson zas kha lag gi 'brel thog thams cad 'khor bar mi 'khyams shing / gnas skabs dang mthar thugs kyi phan bde thob pa zhig bla ma dkon mchog mkhyen zhes snying nas gsol 'debs dang / nged rang mthong thos dran reg gi sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal bdag la smin cing bdag gis ma ṇi tsam bzlas brjod bgyis pa'i dge ba'i mthus sems can thams cad 'phral yun gyi bde skyid la gnas par gyur cig snyam pa'i lhag bsam rnam dag kha zhe med pa'i sgo nas 'gro phan ci nus su yod cing / bstan pa'i rtsa ba dge 'dun gyi sde rnam gnyis nas kyang mdo sngags bshad sgrub chu rgyun ltar bzhugs shing / de dag gi gnas skabs su dge ba rgyun chags ji ltar sgrub tshul ni/ de yang nyin ltar rgyal bstan spyi bye brag la sku drin che ba'i bla ma gong ma rnams kyi dgongs rdzogs dang / bstan dang bstan 'dzin 'gro ba yongs kyi rim gror dmigs/ dus ja lo ja sogs mu 'brel yod khar gzhung zhabs pad rin po che dang / sa skyong sde dge rgyal rabs rnams kyi mtshon ris su ma chad pa'i sbyin bdag tshang mas shi gson dge ba sgrub skabs su 'bud pa'i chos dung dang /

gzhan yang gdung brgyud rin po che chos khri mkhas pa zil gnon du mnga' gsol skabs dang / gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras sogs zab chos rgya chen stsol skabs dang / dbyar dgun gyi chos/ dus mdos dam tshig bskang gso sogs 'dud skabs kyi brda chos dung rin po che dkar po rgyang grags 'di nyid kyi lo rgyus ni/ dpal ldan sa skya la bsngags pa snyan ngag dbang po'i nyer 'tsho las/ klu dbang dbang po'i dpal yon las 'ongs pa'i/ /dung dkar dkar po rgyang grags tshangs dbyangs can/ /thub dbang dbang pos chos 'khor bskor ba'i tshe/ /lha dbang dbang pos phul te 'di lags drangs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus kyi chos dung 'khrul med byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba 'di/ sa skya pa'i phyag tu rgya nas byung ba'i tshul ni gong ma se chen rgyal pos bla chen 'phags pa rin po che la phul ba yin la/ de yi gong rol du rgya nag tu byung tshul ji ltar yin zhe na/ rgya gar rgyal po dharmā pha la dang / rgya nag rgyal po de wa rā dza gnyis mthong ma myong 'phrad ma myong ba'i grogs po byas te/ rgya gar rgyal po dharmā pha la'i ring la mu stegs pa'i dmag gis shrī na len+d+ra bcom/ bstan pa bsnubs pa'i dus su/ rgya nag rgyal po de wa rā dza la dpung grogs dgos pa'i 'phrin bskur bas/ nged kyi dmag mi thon/ skyes kyi nor rdzas bzang po bskur gyis de la rten nas phyi pa thul/ bstan pa ma 'grib pa gyis shig zer nas/ gos lu hang gi ber srubs med pa ri mos spras shing sra ba/ mtshon dang gzong gis mi phigs pa/ thugs khar nor bu dpal be'u phung phung yong ba cig gi mgo byas skyes bzang po thang gnyis bskur/ gros dang bslab bya legs par byas btang ba'i mthu dang rten 'brel 'grig pas mu stegs pa'i dpung tshogs 'pham par byas te nang pa'i bstan pa nyin mo ltar gsal bar byung bas/

rgya gar rgyal blon thams cad dga' bar 'gyur te/ 'di lta bu'i bstan pa byung ba 'di rgya nag rgyal po khyed kyis sems can brtse ba'i bslab bya dang / skyes bzang po rim par bskur ba'i stobs dang nus pa yin pas khyed drin che ba yod/ skyes lan la ci 'dod pa bskur bas lan bsrings shig byas pas/ rgya nag rgyal po na re/ khyed de ltar sems na sangs rgyas dgung lo brgyad pa'i sku tshad dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos dung / chu klung gi mdo/ rgyan stug po bkod pa'i mdo/ 'dul ba ko sha/ za ma tog bkod pa'i mdo dang bzhi/ dge slong sdom brtson ldan pa bzhi sde dang bcas pa bskur cig zer ba byung nas/ rgyal po dharmā pha la na re/ nged kyi yi dam gyi lha shākya mu ne sogs gzhan du 'byon pa sems kyis thong pa med na'ang khyed drin che bas yin pas gdan drongs la 'gro ba mang po'i don rgyas par mdzod cig gsungs nas mchod rdzas kyi bye brag du ma dang / skyel bsu'i shom rgyas par byas nas jo bo dang chos dung 'di nyid sogs rgya nag tu spyan drangs pa yin cing / rgya nag nas sa skya pa'i phyag tu byung tshul ni/ gong du brjod pa bzhin chos rgyal 'phags pa la se chen gyi phul ba nyid yongs grags yin mod kyang / yang lugs gcig la chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta la rgyal po go dan gyi phul/ sa paṇa gyi 'phags pa la gnang bar bshad pa'i lugs gcig 'dug cing / gang ltar sa paṇa gyi chos dung kyang yin te/ hor gyi yul skad rigs mi gcig pa'i rgyal khams du ma sangs rgyas kyi bstan pas khyab par mdzad cing / chos 'khor bsam gyis mi khyab pa bskor ba'i dus kyi chos dung yin par gsungs pas so/ /de lta bu'i yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos dung khyad par du 'phags pa 'di ni dpal ldan sa skya nyid du 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa rgya nag la phebs dus bsnams nas 'gro ba ma lus pa'i skyabs mgon dam par bzhugs su gsol ba yin no/

/chos dung 'di lta bu che ba'i yon tan ni zhib par brjod kyis ga la langs/ rags pa tsam brjod na gdul bya snod ldan gyis bltas pa de'i tshe/ 'di nyid la rnam bcu dbang ldan la sogs pa khyad par du 'phags pa'i rang byon bsam gyis mi khyab pa yod cing / 'di'i gsung thos pa tsam gyis bskal pa bye ba dpag tu med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dag cing ngan song du skye ba'i sgo bkag ste/ mtho ris dang thar pa'i bde ba la 'god par mdzad cing / gzhan yang sems can la bde skyid 'byung ba'i 'bru'i tshogs rnams la sde brgyad gdug pa can rnams kyis tho 'tshams pa'i ser ba la sogs pa byung tshe/ 'di'i gsung thos pa tsam gyis de ma thag tu rang zhi la 'gro ba dang / sa'i bcud 'phel te sems can la bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba yin no/ /bar skabs su sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi sku ring la bstan dgra lha sa rdzongs pa sogs bdud sprul 'ga' zhig gis byed pas lha khang chen mo la bslus rgyab chos rdzas bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang chos dung 'di nyid sogs khyer dus/ sdig spyod kyi yul der bzhugs pa'i gnas ma yin pa dang / slar yang rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi byin rlabs pa'i gnas gdan sa chen po 'dir 'byon par dgongs te/ chos dung gi nang thams cad 'bus gang ba dang / mchod pa'i grwar bzhag pas 'bud mkhan med par mi shis pa'i rtags mtshan gyi rang skad 'don pa sogs mngon sum du mi shis pa'i ltas sna tshogs bstan pa la brten nas/ de 'phral nyid du gdan sa chen po 'di nyid du gshegs pa dang bcas te phul ba yin zhing / 'di lta bu'i chos dung 'di ni dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang khyad par med do/ /'di'i drung du gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi 'dod pa'i 'bras bu 'byung ba'i smon lam ci btab pa rnams gang yin la bsam pa'i don rnams thogs pa med par stsol bar mdzad pa myong grub yin no/

/de lta bu'i chos dung rin po che'i gsung gis bskul nas dge 'dun rnams mang jar tshogs te chos grwa gnyis tshogs nas nyin ltar gyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems kyi bstod tshogs gzungs sngags zab mo kha shas smon lam bcas chad med 'don pa dang / chos grwa lho nas sde snod gsum gyi dgongs 'grel la bshar sbyangs tal ma/ zla ba byung ngo cog la tshe chog rnam rgyal/ kun rig bstan pa gso chog gsung sgrog gtor ma/ sdom gsum rab dbye dang / de'i kha skong gi gzhung skyor/ cho 'phrul dang tha skar gyi tshes gcig nas nya'i bar smon lam spyi dang bzang spyod byams smon gnyis grwa grangs la rtsis pa'i stong phrag brgal tsam rnams dang / lo re nas chos sde lhan rgyas nas mtshan brjod 'bum ther/ sgrol ma 'bum ther/ sher snying 'bum ther rnams dang / bka' 'gyur yongs rdzogs tshar gsum/ kun rig sgrub mchod nyin lnga la durga grwa grangs la rtsis pa'i 'bum phrag bzhir nye dang / mjug tu smon lam gdan sa chen po lo re bzhin bsngo 'brel zhu ba'i gshin po'i ming byang tshang ma klog pa'i bsngo smon bcas pa/ yang chos grwa lho nas dbyar dgun nyi ldog dang bstun lung rig bshad pa sbyor bkod sogs kyi dga' ston gzhis phyogs kyi dge 'dun rnams nas rgya cher spel ba nyin bdun ma re/ ston ka'ang rig cha bzang po nyin gsum ma re/ chos grwa byang nas zla ba byung ngo cog la rtsa rgyud brtag gnyis/ rgyud 'don zhag lnga drug gang rigs/ nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub mchod zhag bzhi la om̐ gsum ma grwa grangs kyi bsags ba'i bzhi khrir nye ba/ sa lo/ sngags 'chang yab sras/ mus chen/ a mes zhabs yab sras rnams kyi dgongs rdzogs bla mchod la bla ma gong ma sku drin can rnams kyi sku bstod stobs che ba/ mchod 'bul smon lam gyi mtha' brten bcas/ sman bla'i mdo chog tshar re/ bstan srung khyad par can rnams kyi bskang bshags rnams chad med dang /

rta zla ba la zhag bco lnga sman bla'i mdo chog mjug tu smon lam 'gro gang che/ bdag med ma'i sgrub mchod zhag lnga/ dbo zlar kyai rdor zhag lnga/ bstan pa spyi rim gyi gtor bzlog zhag lnga/ nag zlar dam tshig bskang gso zhag bdun/ sa dkar gsang 'dus sgrub mchod zhag dgu dang / chos sde gnyis tshogs kyi dge tsha chen mo/ mgon po'i mdos gtor/ lnga par bde mchog sgrub mchod zhag brgyad dang kyai rdor zhag dgu/ chos sde gnyis tshogs kyi mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan dang 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyi dgongs rdzogs bla mchod shin tu rgyas pa re re/ chu stod zla bar gsar 'dzugs chos sde lhan tshogs kyis kun rig zhag gsum/ bdag med sgrub mchod zhag drug dang kyai rdor sgrub mchod zhag gsum/ tshes bzhi la dge tsha chen mo/ lhums zhugs dus mchod/ gro bzhin zla bar phur sgrub chen mo zla gang / brgyad par gsang 'dus sgrub mchod zhag bcu gsum/ dgu par chog mang zhag dgu/ sman bla zhag bco lnga smon lam bcas/ bcu par mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub mchod zhag drug mjug tu bstan pa spyi rim gyi gtor bzlog zhag lnga/ mgo zlar bde mchog sgrub mchod zhag bcu gsum/ mjug tu dus mdos chen mo zhag brgyad/ bcu gnyis par gtor spod chen mo zla phyed lhag tsam/ zla mjug bstan pa spyi rim gtor bzlog zhag bdun bcas/ de dag gi gnas skabs su bcu gcig pa'i bde mchog dang / lnga pa'i kyai rdor/ bdun pa'i phur sgrub/ brgyad pa'i gsang 'dus rnams la ser 'du chen mo sbyin/ gnas bzhi stong la nye ba'i grub mtha' ris med kyi chos spyod 'don pa bcas gang 'khod de dag gi gnas skabs su dus ja lo ja stobs che ba/ dge 'dun gyi gsol phogs/ chos thog dang dgu gtor gyi 'jam tshul/ sgrub mchod gtor bzlog bskang ba sogs kyi zhabs tog ser 'dul sbyin gtong / rtse gdong chos sde che chung / skyes lhas/

byas 'gyur/ phru ma sgrub sde/ rin chen sgang rnams kyi phogs/ ja tshul gtsug lag khang dang mgon khang khag mang gi mchod me zhal zas gtor 'dzugs gtor gso sogs mchod rgyun nar ma/ lo bstar gyi dbus gtsang grub mtha' ris med kyi dgon khag gsum brgya kha yar la mang ja bzhi re bsngo brten bcas pa 'gro ba gzhis byes kun tu 'phar ma'i rigs rgya che zhing / gtsug lag khang nyams gso rten gsum gyi zhabs tog de dag gi dge thebs stod smad bar gsum gyi sgar pa gang la gang 'tshams kyi mthun sbyor bgyid dgos bcas gdan sa chen po 'di nyid ni sngon dus khri skor bcu gsum gyi zhabs tog sgrub yul yin pa la deng sang mchod gzhis phon chung gis zhabs tog nan tan sgrub khul yin kyang / byi tshang du rta rmig mi shongs ba'i dpes mchod gzhi kho nas gdan sa'i zhabs tog ma 'phrul bar brten sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po nas bzung bla ma gong ma rim can gyis stod smad bar gsum du 'bul bskul ba khag mang rdzongs brda gnang bar/ sbyin bdag dad can rnams nas dge ba 'brel thogs rgya che spam mtho phul ba'i mthus deng sang gi bar du yang dpal ldan sa skya'i dgon gnas rten dang brten par bcas pa thams cad gdul bya phal mo che'i bsod nams kyi zhing bla na med par bzhugs pa 'di yin cing / 'on kyang da dung gtsug lag khang dang dge rgyun grangs mang ba'i stabs kyis dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la zhabs tog bsnyen bskur ha cang gi rngo thogs pa zhig mi 'dug pa nas/ bla ma gong ma'i tshul sgrub mchod dkar me dus ja'i dge rgyun mi nyams dbyar mtsho ltar spel zhing / gdul bya rnams kyi rgyud la bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya cher rdzogs pa'i phyir smad mdo khams lho byang / lcam mda' rgya ston/ khyung po dkar nag ri bo che/ nang chen/ chab mdo/ gra yag dgon phan tshun/ be re shog dgu/ lha thog go 'jo/

rgyal mkhar/ rabs yangs/ 'jus/ rgyas thang / rdzong sngon/ 'ba'/ 'ba' chu wa/ li thang / nyag rong gru pa/ mi nyag dar rtse mdo/ lcags la rgyal po/ dge bshes hor brag 'go nyag rong stod smad/ ra tu spre'o/ /khang gsar/ ma zur/ be ri/ re mgo gling tshang / gra'u/ rong po/ sgar ra nyag khri 'du/ rag shul stod smad/ dge rgyas stod smad rnams kyi sa'i char gnas pa'i skye bo rnams longs spyod kyi 'byor pa dang ldan zhing dge phyogs la snying stobs che bas nas rang gzhan kun la dge ba'i lo tog rgya cher spel phyir bla ma sgar pa 'di pa chung ngu nas sngags phyogs kyi yon tan sbyangs pa che zhing / dbang lung man ngag kyang mi dman tsam thob khul dang / lhag par lha'i bsnyen sgrub dgos gal che ba kha shas las su rung zhing / dbang bka' rjes gnang 'phral gyi rkyen sel kyang 'os 'tshams yod tshod bcas ched gtad kyi rdzong bar byas pa yin pas/ gong bkod bde bar gshegs pa'i rten khyad par can/ dge 'dun gyi sde dang bcas pa'i zhabs tog la dmigs nas/ nor zang zing gi dngos po bzang zhing rgya che ba 'byor ldan rnams nas nam mkha' mdzod kyi bang mdzod kha phye ba lta bu 'bul ba dang / 'bring dang tha ma rnams kyi kyang rang rang gi tshogs gsogs sgrib sbyong du dmigs che 'byor chung 'byor ci nus su stobs pa dang / sgar pa dpon g.yog rnams la 'phral gyi mthun rkyen lam 'phrang chu sogs kyi 'jigs pa las sgrol zhing mi khal tshang ma'i lto chas la'ang phan 'gyur yod pa can/ khyed sbyin bdag tshang mas mgo 'don bdag gnyer phyogs na mi yod bgyis tshe 'di pa'i lag 'byor mtha' dag gdan sa chen po stobs pa dang chabs cig nged rang nas bla ma gong ma ye shes spyan ldan rnams kyi thugs dgongs yongs su rdzogs shing / bstan 'gro'i phan bde mi nyams dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas pa dang / khyad par sbyin pa'i bdag po rnams kyi 'di phyi bar do gsum gyi don bde klag du grub pa'i phyir sku gsung thugs rten gtsug lag khang dang bcas pa'i nyams gso tshul sgrub mchod dkar me/

dus ja chos srung bskang bshags gtor bzlog rnams kyi cha rkyen du cis kyang mi nub pa zhig bgyis nges/ skyabs 'gro bsrung 'khor bsngo smon shis brjod rnam par dag pas rgyas gdab ste dge ba'i rtsa ba nam yang ma dor chab mi 'tshal ba'i lhag bsam yang dag bgyis pas khyed tshang mas de ltar go dgos shing dang / yang 'di pa'i thad du spyir rgyu 'bras mi bsam zhing / lhag par dpal sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma rnams kyi bod gangs can yongs rdzogs bde skyid kyis bskyangs pa'i sku drin dang / gdan sa chen po na bzhugs pa'i sku gsung thugs rten grangs med dang / mdo sngags bshad sgrub 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun gyi sde bzhugs pa la ji snyam du yang mi sems par ar jag rkun gsum/ dbang che shed mang / 'bul ba'i kha 'gengs/ don med kyi phrag dog khrel med lab gzir 'khrugs rtsod sogs dug gsum gyis kun nas bslangs shing / 'dir snang yud tsam la shin tu chags pa'i las ngan sna tshogs byas pa shar tshe/ spyir rgyu 'bras kyi bden pa thog tu smin pa dang / sger khams gsum thams cad dus gcig tu gsol bar nus pa'i rdo rje'i chos skyong ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams nas gzhan gyis ma bskul yang rdo rje 'chang gi spyan sngar bstan pa bsrung bar mdong gsol du zhal gyis bzhes pa'i dbang las/ nyams pa tshar gcod rjes 'dzin bstan la dga'/ /zhes bla ma sa chen gyis ji ltar bka' stsal pa de nyid mngon du gyur bas so so nas 'phral yun kun tu dge ba'i lhag bsam rnam dag bskyed pa shin tu gal che/ zhes bskal bzang sgron me stong gi mngon par byang chub pa'i gnas 'phags yul rdo rje gdan nas byang phyogs su dpag tshad brgya sgrod pa'i sa gtsang grom pa la stod dpal ldan sa skya'i dgon pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang dpal stobs kyi mgon pos mngon sum du byin gyis rlabs pa'i gnas 'og min rgyal ba rigs lnga'i zhing khams dang ches mtshungs la/

mdo sngags bshad sgrub kyi sgra snyan dus 'khor mo yug tu sgrog cing srid zhi'i phun tshogs thams cad rgya mtsho la chu bran 'du ba ltar ngang gis 'bab pa'i gnas na sngon dus gdung brgyud bzhugs pa'i bla brang go bzhi/ brgya dpon brgya 'dra'i bla brang sogs che chung thams cad sdom/ bzhi bcur nyer tsam bzhugs pa'i nang nas kun gyi tog ltar gyur pa'i bzhi thog bla brang zhes thog mar bzhi thog gdung brgyud rnams kyi bsti gnas dang / phyis su gdan rabs rim can gyi bla brang kho na mdzad de/ mdo sngags rig gnas bcas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun ma chad par bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang chen po de yi yang rtse bde chen 'od gsal thos bsam 'brug sgra tshal nas rje btsun gong ma de dag gi dbon gyi tha shal za nyal chag gi rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos myos ldan gyi lo rgyal zla ba'i yar ngo'i bdun la bris pa phyogs dus kun tu dzayan+tu/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// ༈ /om̐ swasti/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po/ 'dod khams dbang phyug lha mo nam gru ma/ dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi/ dur khrod bdag po yab yum/ dam can gnod sbyin pho mo/ bka' sdod pu tra ming sring / bran bdud gshin rje nag po/ dkar mo nyi zla lcam dral/ phur srung dam can bcu gnyis/ 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje/ dpal bsam yas lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang gi dkor bdag rgyal po pe har 'khor dang bcas pa/ dam can bstan ma bcu gnyis/ snang srid lha srin sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs rnams kyi gnod byed thams cad brtan zhing skyobs pa'i lha dang phrol/ gnam gyi 'ju thag chod/ sa yi rten phur phyung / ltas ngan brgyad bcu rtsa bzhi thongs/ snying khrag thang la phos/ 'bar ba'i hoṃ khung du bcug nas/ rdo rje'i thun gyis brabs te rnam smin gyi sha khrag rus dum bur thongs la/

rnam par shes pa mi bskyod pa'i zhing du skyol cig ji ltar bka' bsgos pa bzhin du chos skyong srung ma las byed kyi pho nya dang bcas pas stong grogs mgon skyabs phrin las thams cad thog pa med par grub par mdzod// //zhus// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 16 kun dga' blo gros/ hor rtsa bod rtsar song ba'i spyi 'gro/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 15
